subject: a thick floating stone ring supporting a small pavilion
pose: three-quarter view with the central opening visible
art_direction: 厚石环横悬在雾中，环上小亭与暖色入口细节集中，上方光雾自然大留白。
visible_description: 厚石环横悬在雾中，环上小亭与暖色入口细节集中，上方光雾自然大留白。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a thick floating stone ring supporting a small pavilion. Keep the ring broad and stable-looking, with a simple timber pavilion occupying only one section. Warm light from the pavilion contrasts with cool mist passing through the central opening. The structure stays in the lower three quarters. Leave the upper sky softly luminous and avoid additional rings, symbols, or mechanical supports. Use atmospheric architectural painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
